properties.claim: Snapshot rendering converts non-breaking spaces to ordinary spaces while still removing true zero-width characters.

assumptions.claim: CLI and MCP select operations converge on the same native select_option implementation.
assumptions.evidence: MCP call_select constructs canonical CLI arguments; execute_command dispatches select to handle_select, which calls select_option.

assumptions.claim: Chrome exposes NBSP and zero-width label variants through the accessibility and DOM producers exercised by the fixture.
assumptions.evidence: The real Chrome snapshot and DOM state showed both variants at exact HEAD.

assumptions.claim: Whitespace normalization can be bounded to labels and text without changing opaque value semantics.
assumptions.evidence: The code normalizes only option.label and textContent in fallback; exact case-distinct values remained distinct in Chrome.

assumptions.claim: Exact precedence and ambiguity rejection prevent normalized fallback from silently choosing a different option.
assumptions.evidence: Exact ASCII label selected its own option, while double-space normalized input returned a multiple-match error without mutation.

assumptions.claim: The only recorded review finding on #1701 was mutation on a miss.
assumptions.evidence: The full pull review comments contained one logic finding, followed by Mauricio's fix and the bot's resolved response.

findings.claim: The contributor's first revision mutated selection before determining that no value matched.
findings.evidence: PR #1701 review comment 3816248245 identified the mutation; the recreated E2E forces single, ambiguity, and partial multi-value failures and observes unchanged DOM state.

findings.claim: Deleting NBSP in snapshot output joins words and makes the displayed option name misleading.
findings.evidence: Base rendered `CapitalFederal`; exact HEAD renders `Capital Federal`, and restoring deletion makes the E2E red.

findings.claim: The contributor design widened selection to case-insensitive fallback and did not reject normalized collisions.
findings.evidence: The source PR's wantedFor(true) case-folds all candidate forms and accumulates matching options. The recreated design removes case folding and errors when fallback yields more than one option.
findings.path: community candidate comparison to exact-head matcher
